scenes.basis: Prologue addressed to Theophilus; 1:3 "it seemed good to me also... to write to you in order, most excellent Theophilus" names no place
1:9 "his lot was to enter into the temple of the Lord and burn incense"; 1:22 "he had seen a vision in the temple"
1:26 "the angel Gabriel was sent from God to a city of Galilee, named Nazareth"; 1:28 "Having come in, the angel said to her"
1:39 "went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Judah"; 1:40 "entered into the house of Zacharias"
1:56 "Mary stayed with her about three months" - the Magnificat (1:46-55), John's birth (1:57-66) and the Benedictus (1:67-80) follow at Zacharias's house, which Luke never names
